title: Zoom Named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Unified Revenue Orchestration Platforms 2026
summary: Zoom was named a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Unified Revenue Orchestration Platforms 2026. See what this means for sales teams evaluating AI-powered revenue orchestration solutions and where revenue technology is headed.
body_markdown:
We're proud to announce that Zoom has been named a Leader in the **IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Unified Revenue Orchestration Platforms 2026 Vendor Assessment** , an independent evaluation by IDC MarketScape of vendors delivering AI-enabled revenue orchestration across marketing, sales, and customer success.


## What the IDC MarketScape Assessment Covers


The IDC MarketScape: Unified Revenue Orchestration Platforms 2026 Vendor Assessment evaluates vendors on their capabilities and strategies for enabling revenue orchestration including workflow design, unified data, analytics, customer life cycle, and sales engagement.


*IDC MarketScape vendor analysis model is designed to provide an overview of the competitive fitness of technology and suppliers in a given market. The research methodology utilizes a rigorous scoring methodology based on both qualitative and quantitative criteria that results in a single graphical illustration of each supplier's position within a given market. The Capabilities score measures supplier product, go-to-market and business execution in the short-term. The Strategy score measures alignment of supplier strategies with customer requirements in a 3-5- year timeframe. Supplier market share is represented by the size of the icons.*


## Why We Believe Zoom Was Recognized


We believe Zoom's native architecture, built directly on Zoom Meetings and Zoom Phone, contributed to its recognition as a Leader. This architecture brings conversation capture, AI coaching, deal intelligence, and win/loss analysis together on a connected data foundation.


We also believe ZRA's agentic AI capabilities, including **Sales Assist** for real-time deal guidance, **Ask ZRA** for natural language pipeline queries, and **Sales Roleplay** for rep skill-building, support a more coordinated approach to the sales motion by helping teams move from insights to action.


The commercial momentum behind this recognition is also notable. ZRA customer count grew **50% across FY2026** , per Zoom's FY2026 annual report, underscoring strong market adoption alongside this independent validation.


## What We Believe This Means for Your Sales Team


IDC MarketScape offers clear guidance on when ZRA is the right fit:


> *"Consider Zoom Revenue Accelerator when your sales organization already relies on Zoom Meetings and Zoom Phone as its primary conversation channel and wants conversation intelligence, coaching, and forecasting built directly into that existing communications layer. It is a strong fit for organizations seeking to consolidate video, telephony, and revenue orchestration under one vendor, especially as Zoom extends its platform upstream into buyer and account intelligence."*


Beyond analyst recognition, customer results demonstrate the real-world impact of Zoom Revenue Accelerator.[Barracuda](https://www.zoom.com/en/customer-stories/barracuda/) reported:


- **76% less** administrative time spent on documentation overall
- **5% increase** in lead-to-opportunity conversion rate in just 90 days
- **100-140% sales targets** achieved by reps following ZRA deployment
